tier.1.title: Zero
tier.1.subtitle: Bedroom Producer
tier.1.focus: Can he DJ without breaking everything? Will he show up?
tier.1.whoDecides: Friend / micro-venue owner / another local DJ
tier.1.action.1.desc: A real 3–5 min mix. Upload to SoundCloud. Test it in your DJ app.
tier.1.action.2.desc: Know your DJ controller/turntables. Don't embarrass yourself at first gig.
tier.1.action.3.desc: Show up on time. Bring your gear. Don't get drunk. Just play.
tier.1.action.4.desc: Even just phone camera. You need video proof to ever book a real gig.
tier.1.action.5.desc: Did people enjoy it? Did you mess up? Learn from it. Don't lie to yourself.
tier.1.metricsExplain: You won't have metrics yet. Nobody cares. You're learning. Focus on not failing the first gig.
tier.1.concerts: 🎤 Zero gigs = this is prep. You're learning to DJ. First gig = your friends + maybe 5 people watching.
tier.1.warning: 💡 Forget metrics. Forget followers. Can you play 60 minutes without losing the room? That's the only question.
tier.2.title: First Release
tier.2.subtitle: Starter
tier.2.focus: He made real music. Not just talking about it.
tier.2.whoDecides: Small promoter / underground event / friend with a party
tier.2.action.1.desc: Via Distrokid/Tunecore. Distribute to Spotify/Apple. It's proof you're serious.
tier.2.action.2.desc: Post the release. Post 2–3 times per week. Show that you exist.
tier.2.action.3.desc: Upload the track + 1–2 simple mixes. DJs search "Afro House mixes" on SC.
tier.2.action.4.desc: "I just released [track] on Beatport. I'm available [date]." Include Spotify link.
tier.2.action.5.desc: Even free. Even in a bar. Get the experience + video proof.
tier.2.metricsExplain: As side effect: Spotify 1k–5k (from your release + friends), Instagram ~500 (you posted), Beatport listing (proof you distributed).
tier.2.concerts: 🎤 First real gigs = 1–2 small events/month. Maybe free or $0–50. Promoter is testing if you're reliable.
tier.2.warning: 💡 The release is your legitimacy card. Without it, you're just a person with dreams. With it, you're an artist.
tier.3.title: Local SP
tier.3.subtitle: São Paulo Proof
tier.3.focus: He's not unknown. He can DJ. He's part of the scene.
tier.3.whoDecides: Club promoter / São Paulo collective / small booking agent
tier.3.action.1.desc: 15–30 min, decent audio, show the mixing and crowd reaction. This is the #1 proof.
tier.3.action.2.num: 2. Play 3–5 local gigs in São Paulo
tier.3.action.2.desc: Even small venues, bars, collectives. Goal: get video, photos, venue tags, real references.
tier.3.action.3.desc: On small/real labels, consistent quality. Beatport listing. Shows you're creating, not just playing.
tier.3.action.4.desc: 1 page: bio, photo, Spotify link, past events, fee range. Make it easy for promoters to understand you.
tier.3.action.5.desc: Know local DJs, collectives, promoters. Be visible at events. Get tagged. Be part of the conversation.
tier.3.metricsExplain: As side effect: Spotify 10k–100k (from gigs + releases), Instagram 2k–10k (venue tags + scene people follow), Beatport Top 500 (3–5 releases), Videos 1–3, Local gigs 3–5.
tier.3.concerts: 🎤 Regular bookings = 3–5 gigs/month in São Paulo. Promoter books because risk is low: you can DJ, you have proof, you fit the vibe.
tier.3.warning: 💡 You don't need 100k followers. You need 1 good live video, 3–5 past gigs, and ability to pitch yourself. Video > everything.
tier.4.title: Regional BR
tier.4.subtitle: Brazil Scene Artist
tier.4.focus: He plays multiple cities. His music is known in the scene.
tier.4.whoDecides: Regional booking agent / festivals / bigger clubs (Rio, Salvador, BH)
tier.4.action.1.num: 1. Release on real Afro House labels
tier.4.action.1.desc: Not micro-labels. Real ones. Shows gatekeepers approved you.
tier.4.action.2.desc: Not just São Paulo. Rio, Salvador, Belo Horizonte, etc. Prove you can tour.
tier.4.action.3.desc: From good venues/festivals. Show progression. Quality matters now.
tier.4.action.4.desc: 15k+, mostly from Brazil. Engagement from real scene people, not bots.
tier.4.action.5.num: 5. Connect with booking agent or manager
tier.4.action.5.desc: Stop pitching yourself. Let an agent handle other regions. Focus on music.
tier.4.metricsExplain: As side effect: Beatport Top 30 (5–10 quality releases), Spotify 50k+ (regional demand), Instagram 15k+ (Brazilian followers from scenes), Videos 3–4 professional, Regional gigs 8–12/month.
tier.4.concerts: 🎤 Regional expansion = 8–12 gigs/month across Brazil. First festival slots. Agent starts handling bookings.
tier.4.warning: 💡 Without a booking agent, regional expansion is slow. With one, you can have 10+ cities. This is where representation becomes real.
tier.5.title: International
tier.5.subtitle: Intl Traveler
tier.5.focus: His tracks are in the international Afro House conversation.
tier.5.whoDecides: International booking agent / European clubs / festival programmers
tier.5.action.1.desc: Black Coffee's Soulistic, Defected, FFRR, similar caliber.
tier.5.action.2.desc: Requires 8–12 quality releases + playlist traction. This is international visibility.
tier.5.action.3.desc: Editorial or known curator playlists. Shows algorithmic demand.
tier.5.action.4.num: 4. Play 2–3 European festivals or major venues
tier.5.action.4.desc: Ibiza, Barcelona, similar. Film it. Proof you can handle big stages.
tier.5.action.5.desc: They pitch you to European venues. You stop pitching. Focus on music.
tier.5.metricsExplain: As side effect: Spotify 100k–250k (international demand), Instagram 25k–150k (EU/US followers), Beatport Top 300 (consistent), Videos from international venues, 15–20 annual bookings.
tier.5.concerts: 🎤 International bookings = 15–20 gigs/year, €3k–6k for EU clubs. Major festival slots. Travel is now part of the job.
tier.5.warning: 💡 International agents work differently. They see your Beatport + Spotify and decide if you're worth booking. You need an agent to book Europe.
tier.6.title: Ranked
tier.6.subtitle: Magazine Cool
tier.6.focus: He's in the conversation. Worth featuring in press.
tier.6.whoDecides: Premium clubs (Ibiza, NYC) / Major festivals / Music media
tier.6.action.1.desc: Requires 12–15 hit tracks. This is when you're shaping the sound.
tier.6.action.2.num: 2. Get features in RA / DJ Mag / music blogs
tier.6.action.3.desc: Tomorrowland, Sónar, ADE, etc. This is big stages.
tier.6.action.4.desc: 100k+ views on live sets. Proof of draw and quality.
tier.6.action.5.desc: 5–10 releases from your label. Shows authority.
tier.6.metricsExplain: As side effect: Beatport Top 10 (consistent), Spotify 200k–800k (global fans), Instagram 150k–500k, YouTube 100k+ views, 30–40 annual bookings.
tier.6.concerts: 🎤 Premium bookings = 30–40 gigs/year. Premium EU clubs + major US festivals. Every booking is a statement.
tier.6.warning: 💡 To reach Top 10 you need: great music + consistent releases + playlist luck + festival exposure. Takes 3–5 years minimum.
tier.7.title: Top Tier
tier.7.subtitle: Brand Headliner
tier.7.focus: People buy tickets to see HIM. Not just the event.
tier.7.whoDecides: Major festivals / Ibiza megaclubs / International promoters
tier.7.action.2.desc: Industry validation. You're in the history of the genre.
tier.7.action.3.desc: Tomorrowland, Burning Man, Sónar headline slots.
tier.7.action.5.desc: Your own festival or monthly party. Brand extension.
tier.7.metricsExplain: As side effect: Beatport Top 5 (consistent), Spotify 800k–3M (global fame), Instagram 500k–1.3M, Media coverage everywhere, 50+ annual bookings.
tier.7.concerts: 🎤 Megastar bookings = 50+ gigs/year. Headline slots only. You're the reason people come.
tier.7.warning: 💡 Most successful DJs peak at Tier 6. Tier 7 requires everything: music, consistency, media, luck. Very rare.
tier.8.title: DJ Mag 100
tier.8.subtitle: Iconic Signature
tier.8.focus: His name IS the event. Generations know him.
tier.8.whoDecides: Legendary festivals / Film producers / His agent (he has power)
tier.8.action.2.num: 2. Stay in DJ Mag Top 100 for 3+ years
tier.8.metricsExplain: As side effect: Beatport #1 (multiple), Spotify 3M–15M, Instagram 1.5M–5M, Grammy nomination, Major awards, Media everywhere.
tier.8.concerts: 🎤 Legend status = 100+ bookings/year, $40k–100k per set. Residencies at iconic venues. Your name sells out.
tier.8.warning: 💡 This is 0.1% of DJs. Black Coffee, Diplo, Carl Cox level. Requires 10+ years + everything aligning perfectly.
tier.9.title: Legendary
tier.9.subtitle: Anti-fashion Icon
tier.9.focus: He changed music. He changed culture.
tier.9.whoDecides: Music history / Cultural impact / Industry looks back
tier.9.action.2.desc: People say "the sound of [decade]" and think of you.
tier.9.action.3.desc: Fashion, activism, art — beyond just music.
tier.9.action.5.desc: Autobiography, film, influence on next generation.
tier.9.metricsExplain: Metrics don't matter. You're in textbooks now.
tier.9.concerts: 🎤 Immortal = Your name on a ticket sells out. You play when you want. You're in music history.
tier.9.warning: 💡 Maybe 10 DJs globally reach this. Not something to plan for. Something that happens if everything aligns.
